title: Illustrative scenario: quarterly results released
detail: Example workflow only: an investor could compare this quarter's revenue and profit with earlier periods. No results or figures are asserted here.
why: Review the actual results filing for growth, margins and variance versus earlier quarters.

title: Illustrative scenario: finance leadership transition
detail: Example workflow only: this is not a report of a real management change at HDFC Bank.
why: Changes in senior finance leadership warrant a check of the official filing and successor's background.

title: Illustrative scenario: proposed acquisition disclosure
detail: Example workflow only: no acquisition or transaction value is being claimed.
why: Check deal size, strategic fit, funding and closing conditions in the source filing.

title: Illustrative scenario: regulatory communication
detail: Example workflow only: this does not assert a real regulatory action against this company.
why: Check scope, financial exposure and whether the disclosure describes a final decision.

title: Illustrative scenario: earnings call transcript available
detail: Example workflow only: a transcript can be compared with quantitative reported outcomes.
why: Guidance and management explanations are useful only when checked against reported numbers.

title: Illustrative scenario: capacity expansion proposal
detail: Example workflow only: no actual factory investment is being reported.
why: Review capital commitment, completion schedule and capacity assumptions.

title: Illustrative scenario: dividend announcement
detail: Example workflow only: no actual dividend or record date is being claimed.
why: A dividend is actionable mainly for its amount, ex-date and record date.

title: Illustrative scenario: rating agency communication
detail: Example workflow only: this is not an actual rating action.
why: Check whether the rating was upgraded, downgraded or reaffirmed, and why.

title: Illustrative scenario: investor interaction schedule
detail: Example workflow only: routine investor meeting notices tend to need less attention.
why: Usually low urgency unless substantive new information is disclosed.

title: Illustrative scenario: routine compliance certificate
detail: Example workflow only: general administrative filings are deprioritised by default.
why: No material trigger is inferred from a routine procedural notice alone.

title: Illustrative scenario: product launch press note
detail: Example workflow only: no actual launch is asserted here.
why: Look for a quantified business impact before elevating a general press release.
